description: Estimate blood alcohol content (BAC) using Widmark formula. Returns: {bac_percent, legal_status_fr, estimated_sober_in_hours}. See list_bundles for related 'sante' calculators.

drinks.description: Number of standard drinks (1 drink = 14g pure alcohol)

name: calculate_blood_alcohol

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").
